test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Class A has 20 students scoring average marks of 75, and class B has 30 students scoring average marks of 60. What is the average of both the classes together?
solution:
Given:

20 students scored average marks of 75

30 students scored average marks of 60

Concept used:

The sum of variables/No. of variables = Average of variables

Calculation:

Let the total average be a.

The sum of 50 students = 50 × a

⇒ 50a

The sum of marks of the 20 students = 20 × 75

⇒ 1500

The sum of marks of the 30 students = 30 × 60

⇒ 1800

50a = 1800 + 1500

⇒ 50a = 3300

⇒ x = 330/5

⇒ 66

∴ The average score of both classes is 66.
